message: `in: query` parameter "aliasOfUnion" has a schema that contains the discriminated union "Target" (at allOf[0]). Discriminated unions are not valid types for query parameters. Fern imports a oneOf/anyOf as a discriminated union when it has a `discriminator.mapping` or when each member has a distinct single-value string `enum`/`const` in the same property; on a oneOf, `x-fern-discriminated: false` imports it as an undiscriminated union instead.

`in: query` parameter "inheritsUndiscriminated" has a schema that contains the discriminated union "Target" (at allOf[0] > oneOf[0] > properties.target). Discriminated unions are not valid types for query parameters. Fern imports a oneOf/anyOf as a discriminated union when it has a `discriminator.mapping` or when each member has a distinct single-value string `enum`/`const` in the same property; on a oneOf, `x-fern-discriminated: false` imports it as an undiscriminated union instead.
